title: Search
description: Jump anywhere by content: / and ?, * under the cursor, n for the next match, and cgn to change matches one by one.

levels.title: Needle, haystack
levels.description: Something timed out. Put the cursor on the 'p' of 'provider' without scrolling through the whole log.
levels.hint: / followed by a few letters and <CR> jumps to the next match. The fewer letters that still match uniquely, the better.

levels.title: Look back in anger
levels.description: You're at the bottom of the file. Jump back up to the @ in the contact address.
levels.hint: ? searches backwards, like / but up. One distinctive character is often enough.

levels.title: Under the cursor
levels.description: Find the next use of the variable count. Not account, not counter: count.
levels.hint: * searches for the whole word under the cursor (# searches backwards).

levels.title: I before E
levels.description: Fix every 'recieve'. Find the first misspelling, fix it, and let n take you to the next one.
start_text: We recieve emails. Did you recieve mine? I never recieve answers. Please recieve this.

value: We receive emails. Did you receive mine? I never receive answers. Please receive this.

levels.hint: Search for /ie, swap the two letters with xp, then n jumps to the next match. Repeat.

levels.title: Change gang
levels.description: Rename tmp to user everywhere except the print, which is about to be deleted anyway.
levels.hint: With a search pattern set (try * or #), cgn changes the next match and . repeats it on the following one. n skips a match.
